youtube_description:
We spoke to two artificial intelligence pros - Rollo Carpenter, the inventor of the original Cleverbot and George Zarkadakis, author of 'In Our Own Image' - to understand where AI will take us in the foreseeable future. 

This is part of the wider Digital Futures series (http://www.youtube.com/digitalfutures)
